1154|3696a22b.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|3696a22b.text:
Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!

Nonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.

<He claps you on the back.>

Best the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

185403|7e1300bc.name: Cyriden Farseeker
185403|7e1300bc.text:
Elune-adore, traveler. I am Cyriden. My partner Relathor and I are working to unearth the lost artifacts of our people.

Much is remembered by the older kaldorei, but there is no telling what tales have been forgotten. Without our intervention, they will vanish from this world forever.

185404|1c902d7c.name: Relathor Moonsong
185404|1c902d7c.text: My partner and I are archaeologists, hoping to uncover the forgotten history of the kaldorei. It's hard work, but I feel an obligation to preserve the stories of those who came before me.

2057|03d49bcb.name: Huldar
2057|03d49bcb.text: Are you here to help with the delivery? Miran's just about ready.

246848|aa74f3e4.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|aa74f3e4.text: Is there something I can help you with?

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

268568|f87f742d.name: Roy Lewells
268568|f87f742d.text: Literacy should be celebrated and shared.

268925|17da1992.name: Night Elf Courier
268925|17da1992.text: The night elf is motionless, with multiple wounds and discoloration emblematic of suffering from poison.

275243|a3886d45.name: Teller Gee
275243|a3886d45.text: Apologies, sir. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

2913|fa848faf.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|fa848faf.text:
Oh, $N! It's you! I wasn't sure when you'd come back.

What did Tarrel say? Did he... say anything?

3701|3b2b54ce.name: Tharnariun Treetender
3701|3b2b54ce.text: Greetings High Order $N, I am Tharnariun Treetender.

3845|10ec66f1.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
3845|10ec66f1.text: We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.

4077|a1373701.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
4077|a1373701.text:
If I can get the proper ingredients, we can create some explosives that will not only allow me to damage the Venture's Co.'s operations, but also cause a distraction.

I know you're impressed, but it gets better... I'll tell you more soon enough.

4184|dd12f193.name: Geenia Sunshadow
4184|dd12f193.text:
Ishnu-alah, traveler, and welcome to Nighthaven.

Would you like to browse my selection of fine dresses?

4218|8fca8484.name: Denatharion
4218|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

6669|a5e43d8e.name: The Threshwackonator 4100
6669|a5e43d8e.text: Gelkak's key slides into the vacant slot.

1008-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-progress.text: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, $N.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
1008-progress.title: The Zoram Strand

1010-progress.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-progress.text: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $N?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
1010-progress.title: Bathran's Hair

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1020-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-progress.text: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
1020-progress.title: Orendil's Cure

1033-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-progress.text: $N, did you find Iris Lake?  Do you have the Tear?
1033-progress.title: Elune's Tear

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

161-progress.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
161-progress.text: You say somethin', sonny?  Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears.  Say, what's that you got there?
161-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

199-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-progress.text: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
199-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

2098-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-progress.text: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
2098-progress.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

271-progress.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-progress.text:
Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
271-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

272-progress.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-progress.text: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N?  If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information.  Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
272-progress.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

274-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
274-progress.text: What is that you bring from Ashlan?
274-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

278-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
278-progress.text: Do you have the needed items?  Time is of the essence!!
278-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

280-progress.name: Explosive Charge
280-progress.text: The top of the keg slowly twists off.
280-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4725-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4725-progress.text:
It is a pleasure to see you again, $N.  We are making great strives in uncovering the mystery of why majestic sea creatures beach themselves on the Darkshore coastline, but with every question answered, two more are raised it seems.

Are you here to offer us more aid in our research?
4725-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4731-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4731-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  The work you have done on behalf of the Temple of the Moon has been outstanding.  Are we to be blessed with more of your effort on our behalf?
4731-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4732-progress.text: Greetings once again $N - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?
4732-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4733-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4733-progress.text: Thanks be to Elune - I am glad to see you again, dear $N.  The Temple of the Moon's work on the strange beaching phenomena continues here in Darkshore.  Might you have anything additional to offer us?
4733-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4812-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

5061-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-progress.text:
Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
5061-progress.title: Aquatic Form

531-progress.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-progress.text: Great job, $N! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
531-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

6122-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6122-progress.text:
You're the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent?  That's wonderful!  We've quite the crisis our hands here regarding the poor deer, and we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have?  He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
6122-progress.title: The Principal Source

6123-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6123-progress.text: Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve?  The deer aren't getting any better on their own, so we better hurry to help them out!
6123-progress.title: Gathering the Cure

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

741-progress.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-progress.text: What can I do for you, $r?
741-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

78142-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78142-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142-progress.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

86574-accept.name: Night Elf Courier
86574-accept.text:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574-accept.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

86585-accept.name: Mountaineer Ylva
86585-accept.text:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585-accept.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-complete.text:
You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
86585-complete.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

86614-progress.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-progress.text: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614-progress.title: Silver of the Waves

86758-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
86758-accept.text:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758-accept.title: Twisting the Knife

86758-complete.name: Marek Ironheart
86758-complete.text:
Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!

Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?
86758-complete.title: Twisting the Knife

87760-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
87760-progress.text: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
87760-progress.title: Holy Diver

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

92596-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596-accept.title: The High Order

92596-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-complete.text:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
92596-complete.title: The High Order

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $N man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

92701-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92701-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92701-accept.title: To Valanaar

92701-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92701-progress.title: To Valanaar

92709-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92709-accept.text: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709-accept.title: A Grand Adventure

92727-complete.name: Dondallion Whisperwind
92727-complete.text: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain, you notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>
92727-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order do not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92834-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834-progress.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840-progress.title: Catching Wind

92850-progress.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
92850-progress.title: The Missing Scholar

92860-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92860-accept.text:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

92881-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92881-accept.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881-accept.title: The High Elder's Request

93461-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93461-accept.text:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461-accept.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93461-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93461-complete.text:
Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?
93461-complete.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93927-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93927-complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
93927-complete.title: A Last Request

93951-accept.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many $r love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951-accept.title: A Little Beauty

94006-accept.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94006-accept.text:
Greetings, $N. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006-accept.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94006-complete.name: Urs'endris
94006-complete.text: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.
94006-complete.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

944-progress.name: Scrying Bowl
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

94413-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
94413-accept.text:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413-accept.title: A Magical Affront

94413-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
94413-complete.text:
Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.

If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.
94413-complete.title: A Magical Affront

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straits indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94490-accept.name: Unknown
94490-accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the $c den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490-accept.title: Ripped Missive

94490-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94490-complete.text:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
94490-complete.title: Ripped Missive

94491-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94491-accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $N. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491-accept.title: The Fate of the Den

94568-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568-accept.title: The Cult's True Plans

94638-accept.name: Urs'endris
94638-accept.text:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638-accept.title: Strength and Mercy

94638-complete.name: Urs'endris
94638-complete.text:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, $c. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.
94638-complete.title: Strength and Mercy

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

94912-accept.name: Alfina Nightgaze
94912-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912-accept.title: Child of Nature

94912-complete.name: Sheldras Moontree
94912-complete.text:
Greetings, fellow $c. It pleases me to meet a fellow $c from among the $N, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.

I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
94912-complete.title: Child of Nature

94914-accept.name: Sheldras Moontree
94914-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young $c.
94914-accept.title: Moonglade

94914-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
94914-complete.text: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $c.
94914-complete.title: Moonglade

94947-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
94947-complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, $N.
94947-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

951-progress.name: Onu
951-progress.text: $N.  Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
951-progress.title: Mathystra Relics

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

95737-accept.name: Llana
95737-accept.text:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737-accept.title: Seeking Caitlin

95772-accept.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-accept.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772-accept.title: Songblade Search

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-progress.text: Have you acquired that soul gem?
970-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97005-accept.name: Bainham
97005-accept.text:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97005-complete.name: Bainham
97005-complete.text:
My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the Alliance. Thank you.

Go with honor, $N.
97005-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97005-progress.name: Bainham
97005-progress.text:
It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down.

This far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.
97005-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97234-accept.name: Roy Lewells
97234-accept.text:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
97234-accept.title: Reading Room

97234-complete.name: Donyal Tovald
97234-complete.text:
Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique. 

Well, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.
97234-complete.title: Reading Room

97237-accept.name: Donyal Tovald
97237-accept.text:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, $N.
97237-accept.title: Shelf Picked

97237-complete.name: Roy Lewells
97237-complete.text:
These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.

Cellar after hours, of course.

Thanks for the quick errand run, $N. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
97237-complete.title: Shelf Picked

97237-progress.name: Roy Lewells
97237-progress.text: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237-progress.title: Shelf Picked

97914-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
97914-accept.text:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914-accept.title: Expanding Horizons

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

97969-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97969-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97969-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97969-complete.name: Indari Sunseam
97969-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97969-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

98013-accept.name: Arbal
98013-accept.text:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $c. War... is what we will bring.
98013-accept.title: Swelling Forces

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-complete.text:
It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her descent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025-complete.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98042-accept.name: Skyborne
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-complete.text:
<Thundris does not speak for some time.>

This bears the mark of an ancient evil, $c. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.

Ande'thoras-ethil.
98042-complete.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98071-accept.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071-accept.title: Brewer's Trade

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98341-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98341-accept.text:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
98341-accept.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98341-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98341-complete.text:
Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.

I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of an Azerothian cat spirit.

Let us begin.
98341-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98393-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
98393-accept.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young $c. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393-accept.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98393-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98393-complete.text:
And so it continues, Father Cenarius.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>

Greetings again, $N. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.
98393-complete.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98397-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98397-accept.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397-accept.title: To Darnassus

98397-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
98397-complete.text:
Welcome back, $N. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.

I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.
98397-complete.title: To Darnassus

98404-accept.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-accept.text:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
98404-accept.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-complete.text:
Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $c.
98404-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-progress.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-progress.text: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404-progress.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98423-accept.name: Unknown
98423-accept.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423-accept.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98459-accept.name: Tom "Half-fish" Wilson
98459-accept.text:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459-accept.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-complete.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-complete.text:
<Bart unwraps the gift.>

Why that no good, son of a--

Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!

I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--

I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
98459-complete.title: A Lack of Virtue

98459-progress.name: Bart Tidewater
98459-progress.text:
Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!

Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
98459-progress.title: A Lack of Virtue

98461-accept.name: Archaeologist Hollee
98461-accept.text:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461-accept.title: Unrequited Love

986-progress.name: Terenthis
986-progress.text: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
986-progress.title: A Lost Master

98738-accept.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98738-accept.text:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.

Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.

May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.
98738-accept.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98738-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98738-complete.text:
<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.

Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.
98738-complete.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

99260-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
99260-complete.text:
Thank you for saving Fillion, $N. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.

Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth are in serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.

As ever, their own dogmatic hubris takes precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.
99260-complete.title: Fillion's Mission
